newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan airline shares rise due to lower oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Japan airline shares rise due to lower oil prices.

text.p: Shares in airline companies were higher in late Friday afternoon Tokyo trade, encouraged higher by lower crude oil prices, brokers said.
Japan Airlines Co Ltd shares were up nine yen at 659 yen. All Nippon Airways Co Ltd was up six yen at 955 yen.
"Lower crude oil prices mean that jet fuel prices will fall also, which is good for airlines," one broker said.
In New York trade on Thursday, the price of December NYMEX light crude tumbled 93 cents to $23.35.
